desc: The Luth-AR Lightweight Complete Upper Barrel Assembly starts with a Luth-AR 5.56mm Lightweight barrel made from 4150 Chrome Molly with a 1-9" twist mated to a Luth-AR A3 Flattop receiver which includes a Luth-AR bolt carrier, charging handle, forward assist and ejection port cover. The upper is then topped off with a Luth-AR lo-profile gas system and the Luth-AR ergonomic 9" Palm Handguard(R) with KeyMod slots and a Picatinny top-rail.
